I am a fifth-year Ph.D. student in mathematics at **Michigan State University**,
working with Georgios Pappas. I completed a B.S.–M.S. dual degree at IISER Tirupati
in 2022, where I worked with D. S. Nagaraj and wrote my master's thesis on class
field theory.

I am broadly interested in **arithmetic algebraic geometry**, specifically finite
group actions on algebraic varieties and the Galois module structure of their
cohomology groups. Recently I have been working on Deligne–Lusztig varieties; see my
[preprint under preparation](research/dl-gl3.qmd) and the [research](research.qmd) page.

Outside mathematics, I enjoy Carnatic and Hindustani classical music, playing the
bansuri (Indian bamboo flute), badminton, literature, and social justice advocacy.

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple" icon=false}
I am on the academic job market for positions starting **Fall 2027**.
:::

## Research interests

- Galois module structure and Deligne–Lusztig varieties
- Computational aspects of Drinfeld modules
- Arithmetic statistics of class groups of number fields
